propositions: configure_logging() sets propagate=False on the shared 'rebar' logger at module level, permanently disabling log propagation to the root logger for the rest of the process
caplog assertions on rebar.* loggers fail silently after configure_logging() runs in the same process because records no longer propagate to the root handler that caplog uses

the failure is order-dependent and nondeterministic across test runs because test execution order varies, making it undetectable in some full suite runs but reproducible when configure_logging() is called before a caplog assertion within the same test phase
propagate=False was introduced to prevent double-logging through uvicorn, but this goal can be achieved without mutating the shared logger's propagate flag
the fix must restore or avoid modifying the rebar logger's propagate state so that caplog continues to capture rebar.* records in tests while still preventing double-logging in production
